title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 124.797932329529: grouped early abort, 256-record blocks, 46-bit d4

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins, with no heuristic: the Chen-Stein method on cross-node leaf pairs bounds P(no collision), and drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the enumerated carry sites of section 3.4 and the caps of two meters are charged failure rows (section 6, in success.md). Its expected total work is at most 2^124.797932329529 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit; certificate.py gives at most 267.6566 per leaf), E-averaged over 32 X-groups stopping at the first resolving group with prefix non-stopping bounds; worst-case work on every run is at most 2^134.996781 instructions, disclosed. Each pair of generator points X, Y gives six leaves, the x-coordinates of phi^t(X) +- Y for t = 0, 1, 2, from one batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2, held as their discrete Fourier transform: with a = x_X, b = x_Y, E = b^4 + 2a^3 b, F = a^4 + 2ab^3, G = 3a^2 b^2 and w = 1/(y_Y +- y_X)^2, the leaves are (Ew - b) + beta^t (Fw - a) + beta^(2t) Gw, and only the six components Ew, Fw, Gw are computed (section 3.1). A class's label is the top 100 bits of v*/p and (beta v* mod p)/p, v* = min(x, beta x, beta^2 x); each leaf's fractions are sums of its components' fractions with stored correction words, within [-73, 73], [-73, 206] and [-212, 146] at 128 bits, and a leaf in the window set W or the label-error set D' (rates below 2^-58.47 and 2^-17.38 per leaf) is a charged missed collision (section 3.3); a lattice count bounds a box of label values at 1 + 2^-18 times its share. Records go in blocks of k = 256 (2^14 stride, TBZ slot test, flush 8, dlvk 1026) over two hops (emit 7, h2s 7.25) with 13.796875 per record for grouping at a 46-bit d4 (sections 2.1, 4); every delivery is charged as executed route.s code and links keep no state. Peak memory at most 2^135.9989 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^110.1487 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks the declared figures. Credits are in section 9 and the declared dependencies; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. This is an analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run the leaf kernels on production points against exact arithmetic (components, the Fourier identity, records against a bit-exact model of keys, indices and labels outside W and D') and the class-rule and class-label tests; the emit, both hops (each message delivered by executing dlv or dlvk) and the grouping on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py); the grouped early-abort run with stop and full cases (grouped_paths); the sites and fixups of section 3.4 (sites.py); every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
